guard_policy: Apply only if exact English source and old proposal strings and hashes match; do not modify frozen drafts. All accepted target values are in pair-decisions.json.

refinements.key: Your song title and instrument filter are sent to TelemetryDeck. Do not include personal information.
refinements.source: Your song title and instrument filter are sent to TelemetryDeck. Do not include personal information.
refinements.old_proposal: A dal címe és a hangszerszűrő a TelemetryDeck szolgáltatásnak lesz elküldve. Ne adj meg személyes adatokat.
refinements.target: A dal címét és a hangszerszűrőt a TelemetryDeck szolgáltatásnak küldjük el. Ne adj meg személyes adatokat.
refinements.refinement_reason: Replace heavy future passive with idiomatic active app voice; still sends exactly title and instrument filter to the named service, without claiming prior delivery.

refinements.key: Your song title and instrument filter are sent to TelemetryDeck. Do not include personal information.
refinements.source: Your song title and instrument filter are sent to TelemetryDeck. Do not include personal information.
refinements.old_proposal: Je songtitel en instrumentfilter worden naar TelemetryDeck verstuurd. Vermeld geen persoonlijke informatie.
refinements.target: De titel van je nummer en je instrumentfilter worden naar TelemetryDeck verstuurd. Vermeld geen persoonlijke informatie.
refinements.refinement_reason: Use nummer from the Request a song anchor instead of the unnecessary English loan songtitel; preserve both sent fields and personal-information prohibition.

refinements.key: Song requests are unavailable in this build.
refinements.source: Song requests are unavailable in this build.
refinements.old_proposal: Cererile de cântece nu sunt disponibile în această compilare.
refinements.target: Cererile de cântece nu sunt disponibile în această versiune a aplicației.
refinements.refinement_reason: Compilare names the compilation operation awkwardly here. Versiune a aplicației naturally identifies this particular app build, consistent with accepted version wording in other locales.

refinements.key: Song requests are unavailable while usage sharing is off.
refinements.source: Song requests are unavailable while usage sharing is off.
refinements.old_proposal: Không thể yêu cầu bài hát khi tính năng chia sẻ dữ liệu dùng đang tắt.
refinements.target: Không thể yêu cầu bài hát khi tính năng chia sẻ dữ liệu sử dụng đang tắt.
refinements.refinement_reason: Use natural dữ liệu sử dụng for usage data; dữ liệu dùng is a clipped literal rendering. This is a descriptive condition, not a quoted renamed control.
Contact takes a person/service rather than the abstract pagalba (help). Pagalbos tarnyba naturally identifies the support service without specifying telephone or email.
